lines:
Responsibilities: Coordinates project records, selected workspace identities, application configuration, capability bindings, and lossless workflow JSON repositories while keeping JSON the sole canonical definition format.
Owned state: logical ProjectRecordV1 and WorkspaceBindingV1 identities, document versions/content hashes, configuration and workflow repository metadata, and discardable read caches; persisted documents live behind repository ports, and secrets appear only as CredentialRefV1.
Public commands/events and ports: ResolveProjectScope, ResolveWorkspace, Load/SaveConfigurationDocument, Load/SaveWorkflowDocument, ImportWorkflowInert, ExportWorkflowLossless, ListBindings, and WatchDocumentChanges; returns versioned Aworkit JSON documents, canonical workspace roots/branch metadata, conflicts, and unresolved-reference facts.
Invariants: unknown workflow nodes, fields, connections, and layout round-trip byte-semantically; JSON bodies are not duplicated as editable SQL records. Import never installs/enables code or grants authority. A working directory is not claimed as a restriction; only a capability implementation that enforces resolved roots may make that claim.
Transactional and failure behavior: saves use compare-and-swap base versions plus atomic temp-write/fsync/rename or a storage transaction; stale writers never overwrite newer JSON. Workspace identity, existence, and configured roots are revalidated at freeze time to prevent time-of-check/time-of-use drift. Unavailable or ambiguous workspaces return explicit blocking diagnostics and preserve drafts.
NFRs: deterministic serialization, schema migration with unknown-field preservation, cancellable filesystem/Git inspection, bounded caches, and Windows/Linux/macOS path normalization tests.
Non-responsibilities: no graph execution, capability invocation, approval, secret value handling, canonical Chat event commits, Git commit/push, or automatic workspace copying.

data.name: Project, Workspace & Configuration Coordinator
data.technology: Rust domain service over schema-versioned JSON repositories and workspace adapters
